contentHtml:
Use this book when application behavior depends on a database guarantee. Start by stating what must remain true after commit. Identify the key, constraint or transaction that enforces it across independent writers, then check the result from another connection.

When you need to… Read
Model a bookable slot and decide which reservation can commit A reservation schema under contention
Decide whether a customer lookup earns the cost of an index Evaluating a reservation index
Change a column while the API and worker run different versions Migrating a booking identity
Decide where the API and worker interpret the result Business rule placement
Check how PostgreSQL implements the guarantee References and adoption notes
